title: Assistant Human Resources Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 Business Unit: Delhi Department: Human Resources To align drive the Human resources function along with the business objectives / goals and provide a competitive sustainable HR framework for the unit. To develop people capabilities in the unit by selecting, retaining, compensating the best talent in the unit. To build a learning organization culture to foster a healthy climate for career enhancements employee aspirations in the unit 
 
 Essential Job Tasks 
 Monitoring and ensuring activities like recruitment, full final settlement, salary cycle, leave calculation, etc. takes place accurately and within as per given standards. Assessing the overall workforce requirement and forecast the attrition level; cushion the unit by making talent resourcing plans accordingly. Monitoring all the exits separations; strive for retaining the employees and study the reason of existing attrition. Regularly review all legal compliances and renew licenses as and when required. 
 
 Areas of Responsibility 
 
 Financials Strategy 
 Assist in preparing the annual payroll budget exercise for the hotel and ensure all statutory dues are incorporated. Assist in preparing the HR Strategy workbook and workforce plan for the hotel. Managing payroll activities and ensure no omission of data occurs. Ensure that all employee salaries and contractor wages are paid on time. 
 
 Associate Life-Cycle Management 
 Develop strategic sources of recruitment such as campus hiring, job portals, social media, internal mobility, role enhancements etc. Assist sign off on the salaries and terms and conditions of selected associates at all levels, supervise adherence to recruitment profile, timelines and budgets. Ensures timely disbursement of offer / intent letters, pre-employment formalities, appointment, confirmation, role enhancement letters to the employees concerned. To maintain Associate Requisition Forms (ARF) are raised for all kinds of recruitment and planned within the approved budgeted headcount. 
 
 Statutory Compliances 
 Adherence to various provisions under various statutory legislations such as Employees Provident fund act, Employees state insurance act, Payment of wages act, Industrial dispute act, Contract labour regulation and abolition act, Payment of Bonus act, Payment of gratuity act, Shops and commercial establishments act, Catering and establishment act, Prevention, prohibition redressal of sexual harassment at workplace act etc., To update the status on adherence to various statutory legislations in the EY application, along with supporting documents. 
 
 Associate Connect Belonging 
 Administers of various employee related facilities such as staff dining, staff accommodation, ladies night drop, Happy Place, Day care centre, Lockers and restrooms, Employee transportation as per the laid down standards. Communication with employees through various communication channels such as Town hall meetings, Notice boards, e-mails, skip level meetings etc., Administers of the STARS - Special Thanks and Recognition System. Follows any other Reward and Recognition program as per practice at the hotel level. Implement all terms finalized as a part of the union settlement and ensure adherence to the same. Coordinate with the union members on various welfare related issues and handle grievances as raised by them. Assist during the wage settlement in preparing the workings and documentation. 
 
 Contract Management 
 Adheres to contractor / vendor management provisions as per guidelines specified. Verifies signs-off various invoices related to monthly payment to contractors. In addition to the above-mentioned duties and job functions, performs any other assignment given by the management within the scope of job 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Graduation, Masters in Business adminstration or Post gradutate diploma in Human resources Management or any other relevant education. 
 
 Work Experience 
 5-7 years of work experience 
 
 Languages Needed in Position 
 Should be fluent in English and preferably the Regional dialect. 
 
 Key Interfaces- External 
 Vendors, Law firms and labour offices. 
 
 Key Interfaces- Internal 
 Human Resource function, Coordination with departments, compliance and internal audit 
 
 Behavioural Competencies 
 Process Excellence Result Orientation Collaborative Engagement Change Championship Growth Mindset Talent Enrichment Guest Centricity Personal Effectiveness

title: Recruitment Team Lead - Non-IT Recruitment
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Recruitment Team Lead - Non-IT Recruitment to lead our recruitment team and manage end-to-end hiring for BPO, BFSI, Sales, Customer Support, Operations, Back Office, Field Operations, and other non-IT roles. The role will be responsible for team management, recruitment strategy, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, onboarding, recruitment MIS, and achieving hiring targets. The candidate should have strong hands-on recruitment experience and the ability to drive a team in a target-oriented environment. 
 Responsibilities 
 Recruitment Team Management - Lead and manage a team of recruiters. Allocate recruitment requirements and monitor individual recruiter performance. Set daily, weekly, and monthly hiring targets. Conduct regular team reviews and performance discussions. Coach recruiters on sourcing, screening, follow-ups, and closures. Track productivity, conversion ratios, and recruiter-wise performance. End-to-End Recruitment - Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requirement understanding to candidate onboarding. Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, databases, walk-ins, job fairs, and other channels. Screen candidates based on experience, skills, salary expectations, location, notice period, and role suitability. Coordinate interviews with HR and Operations teams. Manage offer discussions, documentation, joining follow-ups, and onboarding. Non-IT Hiring - Handle recruitment for roles such as: BPO / Call Centre Executives, Customer Support / Voice Non-Voice, Team Leaders / Operations Managers, Sales Business Development, Back Office / Data Entry, Field Operations, Finance Accounts, HR Administration, ATM / Banking Operations, Other business and support functions. Recruitment Planning Strategy - Understand manpower requirements from Operations and business teams. Develop sourcing plans based on volume, location, skill requirements, and joining timelines. Identify new recruitment channels to improve candidate availability. Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline. Plan bulk hiring drives and walk-in recruitment campaigns where required. Stakeholder Management - Work closely with Operations, HR, and business managers to understand hiring requirements. Ensure clear communication on open positions, candidate status, interview feedback, and joining plans. Escalate recruitment challenges and recommend corrective actions. Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders. Recruitment MIS Reporting - Prepare and maintain daily/weekly/monthly recruitment reports covering: Open positions; Profiles sourced; Profiles screened; Profiles shortlisted; Interviews scheduled; Interviews completed; Offers released; Offers accepted; Candidates joined; Offer-to-join ratio; Source-wise hiring; Recruiter-wise productivity; Pending requirements; Attrition / early dropouts. Candidate Experience Joining Management - Ensure timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Minimize candidate dropouts between selection and joining. Conduct regular follow-ups with selected candidates. Identify reasons for offer declines and no-shows. Maintain a positive candidate experience. Key Performance Indicators 
 Monthly hiring target achievement Requirement closure TAT Recruiter productivity Interview-to-selection ratio Offer-to-joining ratio Joining conversion Quality of hire Recruitment source effectiveness Candidate dropout percentage Recruiter team performance Stakeholder satisfaction Qualifications Experience 
 Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage. 3-5 years of recruitment experience, preferably with experience in Non-IT/BPO/ITES hiring. Minimum 1-2 years of experience managing a recruitment team preferred. Experience handling bulk hiring and multiple locations will be an advantage. Experience with recruitment platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna, WorkIndia, and other sourcing channels will be preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be someone who can personally drive recruitment closures while effectively managing a team. Strong ownership, follow-up discipline, data-driven recruitment management, and the ability to work under hiring targets are essential.
